column1: # EXP-R2-225 all-or-stop interface qualification of Qwen2.5-32B, one arm, one cell.
# The 7B rung's counterpart is campaign_r225_qwen_interface.tsv, which was named before
# a second rung's manifest existed. Each rung gets its own file because the manifest is
# part of a run's identity -- the queue records its SHA-256 in the status file -- so a
# used manifest is never edited to add a cell.
# The gate stops an arm on failure and this is the rung the freeze is most cautious
# about: Qwen2.5-32B is a single-card H200 CANDIDATE, and the campaign's own interface
# entry records its live output width as DECLARED (152064 from config.vocab_size) and
# not measured, because no card was free to read a head off when that stage was
# written. This cell is what measures it. A live head that loads at another width
# stops the arm here rather than producing a number later.
# Card 0, and stage 01 for this rung is a separate dispatch taken only on PASS.
